THE CENSUS EFFECT IS THE REASON THIS CONTRACT MOVES: a TOKEN carries no @profiles gate of its own -- only its consumers do -- so both retired tokens were satisfiable under ALL THREE profiles (measured via ast_pipeline --dump-rule-profiles on the pre-fix grammar: sv_2017 1354->1352, sv_2023 1373->1371, verilog_2005 1123->1121), even though cycle_delay_range is reachable only through SV-gated SVA. This is the OPPOSITE direction from .3.7 (which added 8 symbols and gained 8 witnesses) and unlike .3.8 (which added nothing and needed no re-baseline at all). done_rule: SV is recognized fully_certified when the multi-config certificate-coverage union UNKNOWN reaches 0. Until then the recognized fully_certified-accounting basis is the sound multi-config union (expected_union_unknown), whose residual rule set must equal expected_union_residual_rules exactly (order-insensitive) and be deterministic (byte-identical) across all declared seeds, with sample_parse_failures=0; the canonical single-config accounting (expected_canonical_unknown) is recorded alongside. The union is sound by construction: a rule is credited only when some config POSITIVELY covers it (a proof or a witness — including the VERILOG-2005-PROFILE.6.7 per-profile ProfileEntryUnreachable/ProfileUnproducibleGate proofs, each independently re-derived), never merely because a profile leaves the rule out of its universe.
